# SQLite public headers

SQLite 3.54.0, source ID
`2026-10-09 15:46:58 be8d059e9a49089ab2dce5ed26dd87aaf598fdc5fbe0b107c0dd758464bcd5e3`.

Source: https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540000.zip

These public-domain SQLite headers define the host ABI. The production library
does not contain SQLite's engine. `tools/build-host` downloads and builds the
pinned engine separately for testing.
